name: GameOver ZeuS
description: GameOver ZeuS (GOZ) was a peer-to-peer botnet and banking trojan developed by Russian cybercriminal Evgeniy 'Slavik' Bogachev as a successor to Jabber Zeus. At peak activity in 2012-2013, between 500,000 and 1 million computers were infected, causing approximately $100 million in fraud losses. GOZ was also the primary delivery vehicle for the CryptoLocker ransomware. The FBI took down the botnet in 2014; Bogachev has a $3 million FBI bounty and remains at large in Russia.

sources.title: Backstage with the Gameover Botnet Hijackers — Krebs on Security
